notes: New task-separated dataset training run created 2026-10-16.
Reads the nine canonical JSONL files under data/multitask_bloom_rewrite_separate; the trainer concatenates rows in memory only and does not write merged JSONL files.
Trains Bloom rewrite, QA, and summarization jointly, with 1,075 rows per task in train and 212 per task in validation.
The 135-per-task test split is held out and is not used for checkpoint selection.
Uses batch size 1, gradient accumulation 16, and gradient checkpointing to reduce memory pressure at the fixed 8,192-token sequence limit.
Fresh output and results directories prevent accidental overwrite or implicit resume from previous runs.
The 0.5B Bloom classifier dataset/model is separate and excluded from this generator training run.
